prompt: A photorealistic photo captures a village market at dawn where mist clings to the cobblestones. On the left, an elderly woman in a floral apron stands beside a wooden crate overflowing with bright orange pumpkins. She is handing a small copper coin to a young boy in a blue cap who reaches out eagerly from the center foreground. Next to the boy, a spotted cat sits calmly on a woven basket, watching the exchange with narrowed eyes. To the right, a farmer in a straw hat points toward a stack of green cabbages while speaking to a customer in a grey coat. The customer leans forward, looking at the vegetables with interest. Behind them, a brown horse tied to a post shifts its weight, its breath visible in the cold air. A rusty bicycle leans against the post next to the horse, its chain dangling loosely. In the background, a vendor in a yellow vest arranges jars of honey on a table covered with a checkered cloth. A black dog lies sleeping under the table, undisturbed by the morning activity. Further back, a child in a pink dress holds the hand of a man in a dark suit, both walking away from the camera. There is no modern signage visible anywhere in the scene. There is no plastic packaging on any of the produce displayed.
